[DeepMutation](https://lilicoding.github.io/papers/ma2018deepmutation.pdf) counts killed mutant–class pairs, denominator retained mutants × classes; killing requires an originally correct prediction becoming incorrect. This differs from ordinary killed/non-equivalent-mutant scoring. [DeepCrime](https://huang.isis.vanderbilt.edu/cs8395/readings/testing-dl.pdf) uses training-killable configurations as a reference: |K(test) ∩ K(train)| / |K(train)|, with statistical significance and effect-size checks across retrainings. Training-killability is an operational proxy, not proof of semantic non-equivalence. Survival on a finite suite does not establish equivalence; report confirmed equivalents, invalid mutants, survivors and unresolved cases separately. Neither differential agreement nor mutation score independently establishes the original model’s correctness.

Applied recommendation for the fixed GRU4Rec checkpoint: freeze weights, use evaluation mode, inject each temporary fault separately and restore afterward. Build reference assertions independently of the mutated helper. Wrong-readout oracle: explicitly gather the final nonpadding GRU state; use varied left-padded lengths that distinguish it from count−1. User-row-swap oracle: compare batched outputs against separately evaluated, identified histories; batch permutations must induce corresponding output permutations. Candidate-ID oracle: independently score explicit item IDs; permuting candidate order must permute scores identically and preserve item-keyed results after inversion. Consistent reordering is valid; mismatched IDs and scores are faulty. Confirm each fault changes an observable result on a witness; identical histories, tied scores or coincident indices can mask activation. Predeclare numerical tolerances; HR@10 need not change when a contract fails.

Report detected/eligible injected instances and per-fault results: “3/3 selected faults detected” cannot establish general coverage. Freeze assertions before assessment; reserve diagnostic histories and unseen mutation variants or operator families. [DEEPMETIS](https://p1ndsvin.github.io/assets/pdf/ase2021.pdf) evaluates unseen-mutant transfer through leave-one-out experiments. Use permitted histories only; keep hidden benchmark tests untouched.
